patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The three vertices are retained, while the other eight points are optimized by a fixed-seed multi-start annealed hill climb. Barycentric coordinates make feasibility inexpensive: `u >= 0`, `v >= 0`, and `u + v <= 1` exactly describe the reference equilateral triangle after the affine conversion to Cartesian coordinates.

The optimization score is the minimum absolute determinant over every point triple. Under this affine parametrization this determinant is exactly the triangle area normalized by the area of the containing equilateral triangle, so the search directly optimizes the reported primary metric. A structured near-uniform start and several randomized starts reduce susceptibility to poor local configurations, while the final polishing phase only accepts improvements.
